object.attr: derived: agents built against 0.3.0 give no commit, so such a call is accepted with a warning for one release; MELLON-TRACE-SRS-23 then replaces this requirement (CF-T40). Answered on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If an MCP call gives a link to create without a commit of the target, the MCP server shall create the link and warn that the call gave no commit.
